description: This file defines a set of React UI components for a Drawer (side panel) using the 'vaul' library primitives. It includes components like Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerOverlay, DrawerContent, etc., which are styled and assembled to build a customizable drawer interface.

methods.name: Drawer
methods.description: Root component for the Drawer, renders 'DrawerPrimitive.Root' with passed props.

methods.name: DrawerTrigger
methods.description: Component for triggering the drawer, renders 'DrawerPrimitive.Trigger' with passed props.

methods.name: DrawerPortal
methods.description: Mounts the drawer content in a portal, uses 'DrawerPrimitive.Portal'.

methods.name: DrawerClose
methods.description: Component for closing the drawer, renders 'DrawerPrimitive.Close'.

methods.name: DrawerOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling for fade-in/out effects and background.

methods.name: DrawerContent
methods.description: Main content area of the drawer, includes overlay and slot for content.

methods.name: DrawerHeader
methods.description: Styled header section of the drawer.

methods.name: DrawerFooter
methods.description: Styled footer section of the drawer.

methods.name: DrawerTitle
methods.description: Component for the drawer title, styled accordingly.

methods.name: DrawerDescription
methods.description: Component for description inside the drawer.
